description: The user's decision on one queued approval, and THE ONE PLACE where an explicit yes becomes a push to the watch. 'reject': recorded, nothing is pushed. 'approve': recorded; the result carries the `payload`, a DRY-RUN `call` and `howToPush`; nothing is pushed unless `push: true` is passed in the SAME call, which pushes one new strength guide (adjusted_guide) or, for week_plan, does a DRY RUN unless `dryRun: false` is also passed (a real week push stops at the first failure and is never retried automatically: days already pushed would be duplicated). `push: true` with reject is refused. An EXPIRED item cannot be approved or pushed (it can be rejected), nor can a guide dated before today. Resolving a resolved item returns the first result (`alreadyResolved`) and never pushes twice; an item approved without push can still be pushed once, so this tool is NOT idempotent. A failed push records nothing and can be retried. Real pushes need SUUNTO_APP_NAME and credentials; guides appear after the phone's next Suunto app sync. Demo mode: push: true NEVER calls the push path. Writes the decision locally and may push; a push only creates new guides.

decision.description: approve: the user said yes. reject: the user said no (nothing is pushed).

dryRun.description: week_plan with push: true only: true (default) validates and sends nothing; false pushes for real.

note.description: Optional remark, stored with the decision.

push.description: true (with approve only): also push now. Default false: record the decision and return the call to make. Pass it only when the user has said to push.

name: resolve_approval
title: Approve or reject a queued change (push: true with approve is the only way it reaches the watch)
